ordering_evidence: This protocol is committed after the sealed v242.1 inconclusive readjudication and before any canonical-camera v243 field, residual, metric, summary, or scientific decision is computed. Git ancestry, source closure, exclusive outputs, and the sealed parent inventories are authoritative; the timestamp is descriptive only.
scope: Post-open deterministic implementation gate on the already opened BLASTNet hydrogen-air Case 7 sequence. It changes only the deployment-visible camera-order adapter: every active camera set and its observation blocks are mapped by stable camera ID to one canonical order before building the unchanged physical operator and running the unchanged v242 arms. It is not a learned predictor, external result, wall/RSS measurement, curved-ray result, or real-BOST result.
scientific_question: Does deterministic stable-camera-ID canonicalization remove the v242 floating camera-order ambiguity while preserving the actual FIFO16 warm K14 arm's complete matched-accuracy pass and the failure of all four equal-or-cheaper classical controls?
physical_hypothesis: The v242 and v242.1 sealed arrays showed identical discrete scientific decisions under the original and reversed camera orders, but finite-precision fields and residuals exceeded the inherited implementation bounds. Canonicalizing the same reported camera set before every operator construction should make camera permutations numerically identical without changing the inverse problem, solver depth, cache rule, accuracy thresholds, or exact-call budget.

frozen_data_and_physics.upstream_contract: Reuse without change every v235, v237, v240, v241, v242, and v242.1 Case 7 input, preprocessing, active camera set, stable camera ID, reported geometry, observation, truth, K16 reference, geometry-Jacobi preconditioner, cache rule, metric, gate, and tolerance except for the explicit canonical camera adapter below.
frozen_data_and_physics.dataset: the same already opened public BLASTNet hydrogen-air Case 7 density sequence
frozen_data_and_physics.truth_use: only offline scoring after every canonical-camera field, residual, call ledger, and cache update has been generated and sealed

canonical_camera_adapter.deployment_inputs: the active camera stable IDs, each camera's reported geometry, and its contiguous 16x16x2 observation block
canonical_camera_adapter.canonical_order: ascending ASCII stable camera ID; for this frozen bank cam00 precedes cam01 and so on
canonical_camera_adapter.observation_transform: map each source-order contiguous 512-value camera block to the corresponding stable camera ID, then concatenate blocks in canonical ID order without arithmetic or dtype conversion
canonical_camera_adapter.geometry_transform: build the reported physical operator from the same camera records in the same canonical ID order
canonical_camera_adapter.validation: fail closed on duplicate IDs, missing IDs, block-count mismatch, unknown IDs, or a canonicalized observation that is not byte-identical across original and reversed source rosters
canonical_camera_adapter.tie_break: none; stable camera IDs must be unique
canonical_camera_adapter.permutation_requirement: Original and reversed source rosters must canonicalize to identical camera-ID tuples and byte-identical observations. Because they enter the same deterministic operator and solver arithmetic, all five arm fields, residuals, metrics, calls, and cache states must be exactly equal across the two inputs.
forbidden: sorting by observation values, truth, trajectory labels, metric outcomes, or learned scores
changing camera membership, geometry values, observation values, dtype, solver, cache, depth, threshold, preconditioner, or call ledger
post-result tolerance relaxation or alternate ordering

arms.common_frame_zero: Use the same frozen v235 K16 reference field, residual metric, and 16A+16A-transpose ledger for scientific scoring. Independently require the canonical-camera K16 anchor used only to initialize FIFO16 to match the frozen reference field within the inherited 1e-8 field-recomputation bound.
arms.forbidden_variants: No change to depth, coefficients, initializer, cache rank/update, preconditioner, normalized-BP formula, stopping, regularization, metric, threshold, fallback, arm roster, CNN, FNO, UNO, DeepONet, or GPU rescue.

accuracy_contract.arm_pass_rule: Identical to v242: all 546 frame cells and all 13 complete rigs must pass every absolute and K16-matched cell, p90-higher, and worst gate.
accuracy_contract.control_dominance: Any equal-or-cheaper canonical control passing the complete arm rule blocks a warm-specific advantage claim.

cost_accounting.logical_ledger_boundary: Identical to v242; offline truth scoring, consistency replay, validation, permutation audit, and geometry setup are excluded and separately disclosed.

validity_and_independence.independent_implementation: The formal runner may reuse the sealed v242 formal solver core after the canonical adapter. The independent validator may reuse only the sealed v242 independent numerical core and must not import the v243 runner or v242 formal runner. It independently canonicalizes IDs and observation blocks, rebuilds operators, predictions, metrics, tails, calls, caches, dominance, and the final decision.

decision_order: Any source, parent, canonical-input, exact-permutation, field, residual, metric, summary, call, cache, lower-bound, adjoint, or independent-recomputation failure makes v243 INCONCLUSIVE_INVALID_CASE7_CANONICAL_CAMERA_ACTUAL_K14_SOLVER_CONTROLS_V243.
If the frozen K16 reference is inadequate, conclude INCONCLUSIVE_INADEQUATE_CASE7_K16_REFERENCE_V243.
If the unique canonical-camera warm K14 primary fails any frozen cell or complete-rig gate, conclude FAIL_CASE7_CANONICAL_CAMERA_ACTUAL_K14_WARM_SOLVER_V243 and close this mechanism.
If the primary passes but any equal-or-cheaper canonical control passes, conclude PASS_CASE7_CANONICAL_K14_CALL_HEADROOM_BUT_WARM_ADVANTAGE_NOT_ISOLATED_V243 and report all dominating controls.
Only if the primary passes, all controls fail, and every independent/canonical-permutation check passes may conclude POST_OPEN_CASE7_CANONICAL_CAMERA_ACTUAL_K14_WARM_SPECIFIC_HEADROOM_V243.
